{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq (re-tests)
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
multi_test_count = (df_grouped > 1).sum()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {multi_test_count}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
print('\nSample_seq distribution per patient:')
print(df_grouped.value_counts().sort_index())"}
